name: skill.rights.font_source
input: one served file of a generated build, as written (platform assets as their 148ai-asset:// placeholders), and its path
description: Every font the page loads comes from a known source (Google Fonts). A font file or a stylesheet from any other host, and a font file embedded or stored in the build, blocks. A font only NAMED in font-family is a system font and is not loaded.
